tokens.v: Catch him at full stride driving through standing water — the leading boot bursting the puddle's skin into a low crown of droplets, both open front panels swung back off the torso, rain beading fat and rolling off the wax. 40mm at f/2.8 from knee height, tilted up, tracking alongside; blur living only in the trailing hand. A wet black bollard crosses the near-left foreground soft, cut by the left edge, the soaked road behind returning the sky as one long mirror. Charcoal merino crew underneath, dark work trousers cuffed once, oiled brown boots.
